messages.subject: Login compatibility
messages.body:
The new resolver handles the legacy labels. It converts compatibility forms before directory lookup. The gateway still checks reserved names after canonical normalization and before the resolver.

I saved the last maintenance capture as /notes/maintenance-frame.txt. The capture service kept the lengths but dropped the alias itself.

The relay decoder counts characters, the frame reader expects UTF-16 units, and the transport has its own byte limit.

- Rowan

messages.subject: RE: Login compatibility
messages.body:
The change request moved to the next maintenance window. The reason I was given is that nobody has reported a successful unauthorized login.

Keep the capture. We’ll need those field lengths when we review the change.

— Mara
